correctness.rationale: Exact reconstruction gives 23,804 faces and an acyclic full Hasse matching with critical cells only in degrees 0, 5, and 6. The signed 10-by-157 Morse boundary has a 10-by-10 determinant -1 minor, proving H_5=0 and H_6=Z^147. Hurewicz and Whitehead then prove the stated wedge homotopy type.
risks: Implementation risk is reduced by full Hasse acyclicity, exact integer determinant, rooted-forest count, and full-chain ranks over three fields.
